Removing this receiver does not close the sender still owned by OwnerSlot at line 89. Consequently complete can later send success at line 333. W03-IA01-S002-concurrency-2.claim: Expiring an inflight request does not notify its existing waiters of the cached timeout result.

B remains waiting because A still owns the sender. If A completes successfully at t=903, B receives 200 even though a duplicate arriving at t=902 received the cleanup's 503.
